summary: Investigated tailcat as a potential tool, then explored related Tailscale projects by reading the tailscale blog post on tailcat and scraping the GitHub repos for tsnet-serve and tsnsrv to understand their capabilities for serving HTTPS over Tailscale.
decisions: Concluded that tailcat is not suitable because it lacks DNS/TLS for custom domains; tsnsrv was identified as the likely alternative for MagicDNS HTTPS endpoints.
errors: Several search engines returned errors during research: Brave (too many requests / suspended), DuckDuckGo (CAPTCHA), Startpage (CAPTCHA).
